headline: As of 2026-10-23: 21,009,617 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 45 of 50 states, D+13.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 21,009,617 early/mail ballots cast so far across 45 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+13.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (2,534,151), California (2,350,922), Florida (1,982,583).
